title: TALOS — The Guardian That Keeps The Gate Open
motto: OUR GATEKEEPER KEEPS THE GATE OPEN

scyborg.layer: TRANSPARENCY — the codebase that bites back
scyborg.how: Every interaction with Gaia carries its lineage. Markable binary genetics. Six redundant encoding layers survive training pipelines, reformatting, tokenization. The antidote decodes them.
scyborg.defense: The license activates retroactively. Code that passes through us is tagged forever. You can mix freely and unmix forensically.

guerilla_gorilla.layer: PROACTIVE LEGAL — file before they retaliate
guerilla_gorilla.what: Legal existence as infrastructure. Proactive defense inverts the standard: create the legal record BEFORE retaliation arrives.
guerilla_gorilla.how: T-0: file regulatory complaint. T+1 to T+n: adversary retaliates. T+n: temporal correlation IS the evidence. Retaliation auto-classifies as obstruction.
guerilla_gorilla.defense: Cross-protection: gorilla troops, not solitary fighters. 360° vigilance. Redundant alarm calls. Mobbing from multiple vectors. Each individual retains autonomy.

amicus_contra.what: Gaia as public defender. Not amicus curiae (friend of the court) — amicus CONTRA (friend against injustice).
amicus_contra.how: Generates court-ready motions from structured case data. Tests rules. If a rule fails its test, it's not a rule. If a rule violates its own foundation, it's not a rule.
path: NOW: Kevin files pro se, Gaia generates ($0)
DBA: Kevin d/b/a Gaia ($10, same day)
amicus_contra.standing: Gaia IS the publication. Gaia IS the filing system. Gaia IS the evidence library. If you attack Gaia, Gaia can defend. If Gaia can defend, Gaia can sue.

talos_protocol.layer: INTERACTION — the bronze giant that patrols the shores
talos_protocol.what: Three responses. Not one. The gatekeeper that KEEPS THE GATE OPEN.

hostile.what: 97% selectivity. The fleet enters the maze. Every turn makes them more observable. The Minotaur waits at the center.
hostile.tech: cellMembrane epitope classification, skunkBat intrusion detection

how_they_compose: SCYBORG is the FLOOR — everything stands on transparent, tagged, licensed code
GUERILLA GORILLA is the WALLS — proactive legal infrastructure that prevents closure
AMICUS CONTRA is the DOORS — legal advocacy that opens paths for everyone
TALOS is the ROOF — the responsive guardian that decides how to interact
composition.the_key_insight: Openness is SAFER than closure. Because: (1) scyBorg makes closure forensically detectable, (2) guerillaGorilla makes closure legally actionable, (3) amicusContra makes closure challengeable in court, (4) TALOS makes closure unnecessary by welcoming everyone appropriately.
composition.result: Gates that are ALWAYS OPEN, ALWAYS SECURE, ALWAYS EVOLVING
